<article title="Billing, charges, and invoices">
When you place an order we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both appear for a day or two, which looks like a double charge; the pending one drops off automatically within five business days.

Receipts are emailed when the order ships, and you can download an invoice for any order from the Orders page.

If a charge appears that does not match an order in your account, contact us with the amount and date and we will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

</article>

Customer first name: Dana
<request>
charged twice for one order
i placed order 48213 on monday and my card shows two charges of 189.00. i only bought one tent. please fix this.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for reaching out. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both appear for a day or two after an order is placed, which can look like a double charge. The pending one drops off automatically within five business days.

If both charges are still showing after that, or if they don't match order 48213, please reply with the amounts and dates from your statement and our team will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

You can also download your invoice for this order from the Orders page.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
